CustomObject.description: Runtime registry for code-defined feature flags. Auto-populated when Apex code evaluates a flag key that has no FlipSwitch_Flag__mdt definition. Enables the admin dashboard to discover flags created in code without requiring a metadata deployment.

fields.description: Grouping label for the admin dashboard (e.g. Checkout, UI, Backend).
fields.label: Category

fields.description: Default return value when no targeting rules match. For Boolean flags: true/false. For Variant flags: the default variant key. For Percentage flags: the rollout percentage (0-100).
fields.label: Default Value

fields.description: Purpose of the flag and its owner. Populated by FeatureFlag.define().description().
fields.label: Description

fields.description: Auto-disable the flag after this date. Null means the flag never expires.
fields.label: Expiration Date

fields.description: Apex class or context where this flag was first evaluated. Helps trace where a flag originated in code.
fields.label: First Seen Class

fields.description: Timestamp when the flag was first auto-registered. Set once on insert, never overwritten.
fields.label: First Seen Date

fields.description: Unique flag identifier matching the DeveloperName convention in FlipSwitch_Flag__mdt. Used as External ID for upsert-based concurrent-safe registration.
fields.label: Flag Key

fields.description: Whether the flag is active. Code-defined flags default to disabled (false) for production safety. Admins can enable via the dashboard.
fields.label: Is Active

fields.description: True when a FlipSwitch_Flag__mdt record with the same DeveloperName has been deployed. The CMDT definition takes precedence; this record is kept for First_Seen_Date__c history.
fields.label: Is Promoted

fields.description: Timestamp of the most recent evaluation of this flag. Updated periodically (not every evaluation) to track active usage.
fields.label: Last Evaluated Date

fields.description: How this flag was registered. Code = auto-registered from Apex evaluation. Manual = created directly via admin UI or API.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: Flag type. Boolean = on/off toggle. Variant = multi-variant experiment. Percentage = gradual rollout.
fields.label: Type

CustomObject.label: FlipSwitch Flag Registry
